# Sino Trade Link

> Verified B2B directory and offline sourcing intelligence platform for China's physical wholesale markets.

Sino Trade Link provides verified access to 27,337+ physical factory stalls and wholesale distributors operating inside Yiwu International Trade City (Futian Market Districts 1–5), Huangyuan Garment Market, and the International Production Materials Market in Zhejiang, China. Features physical booth coordinates, verified direct factory statuses, and unmasked stall lines with gated lead verification.

## Core Navigation & Directories

- [Wholesale Market Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory): Search 27,000+ physical stalls, direct factories, and booth coordinates across all Yiwu districts.
- [Market Floor Map & 14 Specialized Stock-Lot Streets](https://sinotradelink.com/market-map): Interactive district floor plan, 4 niche wholesale complexes (Furniture, Building Materials, Production Materials, Timber), and 14 specialized Yiwu stock-lot streets (Meihu & Wuai 80%-off factory overrun streets) with Chinese taxi addresses.
- [China Sourcing, OEM & Freight Playbook](https://sinotradelink.com/sourcing-guide): Interactive CBM, volumetric weight (÷5000 vs ÷6000) & landed freight calculator, EXW/FOB/DDP formula breakdown, 7 shipping methods (Express, AFUC, SFUC, LCL, FCL), 9-step OEM & private label manufacturing roadmap, MOQ negotiation scripts, NNN & provisional patent IP protection, and pre-shipment QC checklists.
- [On-Demand Stall Inspection Concierge](https://sinotradelink.com/concierge): Professional bilingual agent ground service to visit booths, verify stock, inspect material tolerances (plush GSM, plastic burrs, metal salt-spray specs), and consolidate samples into a single box ($99–$299 flat fee, 0% commission).
- [Category Wholesaler Excel Packs](https://sinotradelink.com/category-packs): Download verified wholesale supplier lists and WeChat contacts in curated niche spreadsheets.
- [Global Supplier Onboarding](https://sinotradelink.com/for-suppliers): Application portal for verified manufacturers and international trade suppliers to list on the platform.
- [Public Suppliers API](https://sinotradelink.com/api/suppliers.json): JSON feed of verified market suppliers and stall locations.

## Market Districts

- [District 1 (Toys, Crafts & Jewelry)](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=1): Stalls specializing in plush toys, artificial flowers, jewelry, and arts & crafts.
- [District 2 (Hardware, Tools & Kitchenware)](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=2): Stalls for hardware tools, locks, kitchenware, household appliances, and watches.
- [District 3 (Office, Stationery & Sports)](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=3): School supplies, stationery, sports goods, eyewear, and garment zippers.
- [District 4 (Footwear, Socks & Daily Items)](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=4): Hosiery, daily necessities, shoes, gloves, scarves, and accessories.
- [District 5 (Home Textiles & Auto Parts)](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=5): Curtains, bedding, fabrics, vehicle accessories, and imported goods.
- [Huangyuan Market (Apparel & Denim)](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=60): Men's, women's, and children's wholesale garments and jeans.
- [Production Materials Market](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=7): Raw materials, injection molding, packaging, and commercial supplies.
